name: feature_terms
description: boss-ai F1 / F2 terms the A11-A18 fixtures leave at 0 (code review 2026-11-04, BAI-004 S2 mutants S2-S7, S11, C4): default band 2, 10 mana, an empty boss board, the player at 30 with a 3/4. The boss hand holds 1-cost 2/2s that differ in one F2 term each (vanilla, Spell Damage 1, an aura, Taunt), a 2/3 weapon and a heal-4 on its own hero; the tests damage the boss hero by boss_damage first. Each body's BV differs from the vanilla 2/2's by exactly its term: Spell Damage +2 per point, aura +2, Taunt x1.2 (+0.5 more in DEFENSIVE). The aura is card-effects row 26's shape (all other friendly minions +1/+1) and reaches nothing on an empty board. No card here has a discover or choose_one op.
